translations.web: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
translations.bsb: Do not say, “I will avenge this evil!” Wait on the LORD, and He will save you.

translations.asv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil: Wait for Jehovah, and he will save thee.
